title: Part 13 : 2019: Ceramic Tiles — Methods of Test Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 13 Determination of Scratch Hardness of Surface According to Mohsʼ Scale ( Second Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 13) covers a method of test for determining the scratch hardness of the surface of all ceramic tiles.
clause_3_terminology: Methods of Test Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 13 Determination of Scratch Hardness of Surface According to Mohsʼ Scale

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
